name: Empty state
summary: Shown when a list, search or table has no content. Explains why and what the user can do now.
avoid: Errors while loading: use Alert with Color=Error.
figmaProps: Put one or two Buttons here.
a11y: Title as a heading in the right structure. After a search: announce the result in a live region.
content: Title: what is going on. Text: why, and what the user can do.
do: Offer a way out: clear the search or create something new.
